display.title: The Baal Shem Tov Saved a Neshama, Part 2 (Pesach Sheni)
display.summary_short: On Pesach Sheni, the day of second chances: Reb Yaakov tells the one story he remembers, about the Baal Shem Tov and a bishop, and his host reveals who that bishop really was.
display.summary_long: The storyteller opens with Pesach Sheni: Jews who could not bring the Korban Pesach asked not to miss out, and Hashem gave them a second chance. The Rebbe teaches that we too should ask Hashem not to miss out on the mitzvos of the Beis HaMikdash, and cry out for the Geulah. The story continues. In Rome, Reb Yaakov, the Baal Shem Tov's attendant, tells the one story that came back to him. Ten years earlier the Baal Shem Tov rode all night to a strange city on the morning of a gentile holiday, when a bishop was about to stir up the crowd against the Jews. Reb Yaakov pushed through the hostile crowd twice to tell the bishop that the Baal Shem Tov wanted to see him, and the bishop came and spent a long time alone with the Baal Shem Tov. On hearing this, his host, Reb Moshe, dances for joy and reveals the secret: he was that bishop. A gifted yeshiva student, he had left home for a university in Rome and drifted far from Yiddishkeit, until dreams of his childhood and of the Baal Shem Tov brought him back to teshuvah. Hearing the story was the sign that his teshuvah was complete.
display.lesson: Hashem always gives a second chance: the gates of teshuvah are always open, and when we sincerely ask, Hashem answers.

date.note: 'Today is Pesach Sheni.' Year not stated.

advisories.note: A hostile crowd gathers on a gentile holiday, and a bishop's speech is expected to set off attacks on Jewish homes; no attack happens.

characters: Reb Yaakov, the Baal Shem Tov's attendant
Reb Moshe of Rome, once the bishop
two of the Baal Shem Tov's students

sources_cited.note: Like those who asked 'why should we miss out' on Pesach Sheni, we should ask Hashem for the Geulah.

segments.title: Pesach Sheni: there is always a second chance

segments.title: The Baal Shem Tov summons the bishop

segments.title: I was that bishop
